Excellent! White wins the queen and up material decisively. The main line is **f4+ Kh6 fxe5**, and White has won Black's queen (worth 9 points).

**Best move:** f4+

**Main line:** f4+ Kh6 fxe5 Kxh5 (White is up a full queen)

**Motif:** fork

**Coaching note:**
When checking the enemy king, look for pieces it protects. Here f4+ moves your pawn where it hits both the king and the undefended queen—a royal fork. Black's king must move to escape check, then you simply capture the queen. Always ask: "Does my check attack something else too?"
